sloka: सीतामादायं हस्तेन मधुमैरेयकं शुचि ।पाययामास काकुत्स्थः शचीमिव पुरन्दरः ।। ७.४२.१८ ॥
transliteration: sītāmādāyaṁ hastena madhumaireyakaṁ śuci ।pāyayāmāsa kākutsthaḥ śacīmiva purandaraḥ ।। 7.42.18 ॥

translations.english: Rama indeed sat down on the seat, which was spread with a mat of Kusa grass, and with Sita by his hand, he had the pure Madhu-Maireyaka wine ready.
translations.hindi: अथवा हे राम ! यदि तुम उसको सुनना ही चाहते हो, तो सावधान हो कर सुनो; में कहता हूँ
